stem: Rhea holds three sheets up to the window: clear plastic, tracing paper, and thick cardboard. Through clear plastic she sees objects clearly. Through tracing paper she sees objects, but not clearly. Through cardboard she cannot see objects at all.

parts.text: How should she classify the clear plastic?
Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Objects can be seen clearly through it, so it is transparent.

teacher.key_rationale: Clear seeing means transparent; unclear seeing is translucent; no seeing is opaque.
